name: TypeScript and JavaScript Code RAG
description: Build a modular code indexing and retrieval system for JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Angular, and React repositories.

tasks.name: Scaffold the TypeScript workspace and define shared RAG contracts
tasks.modelRationale: Establishes package boundaries and typed contracts used by every later task; use a code-focused model and review public interfaces before implementation.
deliverables: TypeScript workspace with core, source-indexer, providers, server, and SDK package boundaries
Typed index, chunk, query, result, diagnostic, and provider contracts
Documented runtime and package-manager assumptions

tasks.name: Implement safe repository discovery and ignore-rule resolution
tasks.modelRationale: Filesystem boundaries and exclusions are security-sensitive; prioritize careful path and symlink reasoning with a code-focused fallback.
deliverables: Repository walker with default source extensions and configurable include/exclude patterns
.gitignore and .ragignore handling plus documented default exclusions
Path canonicalization and tests proving traversal and symlink escapes are rejected

tasks.name: Parse JavaScript and TypeScript modules into source-aware symbols
tasks.modelRationale: AST extraction and source location preservation need precise implementation and test-driven handling of JS/TS syntax variants.
deliverables: TypeScript compiler API adapter for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, TSX, and declaration files
Extraction of modules, imports, exports, declarations, and line ranges
Fixtures and diagnostics for supported extensions and malformed source

tasks.name: Add Angular component-template and React component context extraction
tasks.modelRationale: Framework-specific relationships should remain isolated adapters; validate representative inline and external template cases.
deliverables: Angular metadata extraction linking component classes with inline or external templates
React JSX/TSX component metadata linked to owning source modules
Framework fixtures, source ranges, and graceful handling for unresolved templates

tasks.name: Build deterministic AST-aware chunking with citation metadata
tasks.modelRationale: Chunk boundaries directly affect retrieval quality and citation correctness; prioritize source-range tests and deterministic IDs.
deliverables: Bounded symbol-aware chunks with deterministic splitting for oversized symbols
Stable chunk IDs, hashes, paths, line ranges, symbol and framework metadata
Unit tests for boundaries, duplicate prevention, and valid source citations

tasks.name: Define and test the embedding-provider adapter
tasks.modelRationale: A narrow typed abstraction and provider contract tests keep the core independent of any embedding vendor.
deliverables: Typed document-batch and query embedding interface with model and dimension metadata
Validation for batch limits, vector dimensions, and provider errors
Deterministic fake provider and contract tests

tasks.name: Define vector-store and lexical-search provider adapters
tasks.modelRationale: Provider contracts must enforce index scoping and predictable upsert, search, and delete semantics.
deliverables: Vector-store interface for upsert, search, delete, and index inspection
Lexical-search interface for chunk text and metadata queries
Fake adapters and contract tests for index isolation and dimension mismatch

tasks.name: Implement initial and incremental repository indexing
tasks.modelRationale: Coordinates filesystem, parsing, chunking, embeddings, and storage; requires careful partial-failure and stale-record behavior.
deliverables: Index and sync pipeline with progress and per-file diagnostics
Hash-based unchanged-file skipping and safe upsert/removal of stale chunks
Explicit partial/failure states and tests for modification, deletion, and provider errors

tasks.name: Implement hybrid retrieval, metadata filters, and optional reranking
tasks.modelRationale: Retrieval must combine provider results without hiding failures; test ranking, filters, and index isolation deterministically.
deliverables: Semantic and lexical candidate retrieval with documented fusion and deduplication
Path, language, symbol-kind, and index-scoped filters
Optional reranker interface and explicit empty/partial-result semantics

tasks.name: Assemble bounded, cited context for downstream agents
tasks.modelRationale: Context packing must preserve source provenance and accurately report token-budget truncation.
deliverables: Token-budgeted context assembler with deduplication and configurable ordering
Citations for every excerpt, including path, line range, and stable source identity
Tests for budgets, truncation, duplicate chunks, and citation retention

tasks.name: Expose typed SDK and HTTP API for index lifecycle and queries
tasks.modelRationale: Typed API and SDK integration should preserve core contracts and report structured validation and provider errors.
deliverables: HTTP endpoints for create, inspect, sync, delete, and query operations
Typed Node.js/TypeScript SDK with structured request, result, and error types
API and SDK integration tests with runnable usage examples

tasks.name: Complete security, evaluation, operations, and developer documentation
tasks.modelRationale: Cross-cutting path safety, privacy, error behavior, and quality evaluation require a full-system review and executable checks.
deliverables: Security/privacy tests for path boundaries, index isolation, secret exclusions, and provider configuration
Retrieval-quality and latency benchmark harness with provider latency separated
Setup, configuration, index lifecycle, API/SDK, troubleshooting, and limitations documentation
